entities.summary: Devin Robert DiDiomete is a Canadian-born Italian professional ice hockey player who plays left wing. He currently is playing with Gyergyói HK in the Erste Liga. DiDiomete was selected by the Calgary Flames in the 7th round of the 2006 NHL Entry Draft.
